resources.title: How Much Money Can I Make from Scratch Starting with 0 GP?
resources.creator: FlippingOldschool
resources.noteEs: Reto de hacer dinero desde 0 GP que muestra en la práctica métodos de early game y cómo escalar el bankroll. Útil para ver el money making en acción, no solo en teoría.
resources.noteEn: A from-scratch 0 GP money-making challenge that shows early-game methods in practice and how to scale a bankroll. Great for seeing money making in action, not just in theory.

resources.title: 15 Powerful Items You Didn't Know Existed in OSRS!
resources.creator: FlippingOldschool
resources.noteEs: Recorrido por items poco conocidos con usos potentes en la economía y el día a día. Buen complemento para entender qué buscar al flippear y al optimizar tu cuenta.
resources.noteEn: A rundown of lesser-known items with powerful uses in the economy and daily play. A good complement for understanding what to look for when flipping and optimizing your account.

resources.title: The Best OSRS Early Game Money Makers 2025
resources.creator: Patyfatycake
resources.noteEs: Selección de los mejores métodos de gold por hora para cuentas de bajo nivel, con requisitos accesibles. Pensado para juntar tus primeros millones sin endgame.
resources.noteEn: A pick of the best gold-per-hour methods for low-level accounts with accessible requirements. Aimed at earning your first few million without endgame content.

resources.title: Testing OSRS Wiki Money Makers In 2025
resources.creator: Kaoz OSRS
resources.noteEs: Prueba en vivo de los gp/hr que la wiki promete para varios métodos, contrastando teoría contra realidad. Útil para elegir métodos con expectativas realistas.
resources.noteEn: A live test of the gp/hr the wiki promises for several methods, comparing theory against reality. Useful for picking methods with realistic expectations.

resources.title: 175 OSRS Money Making Methods - AFK, PvM, Skilling, Bosses, F2P, & More!
resources.creator: Kaoz OSRS
resources.noteEs: Catálogo masivo de 175 métodos de dinero organizados por tipo: AFK, PvM, skilling, bosses y F2P. Sirve como índice para encontrar uno que encaje con tu cuenta.
resources.noteEn: A massive catalog of 175 money-making methods organized by type: AFK, PvM, skilling, bosses, and F2P. Works as an index to find one that fits your account.
